title: Israel's Eleos built AI for therapists, and in the trial depression and anxiety fell more

trailer.text: Eleos Health is an Israeli company founded in 2020 by Alon Joffe, Alon Rabinovich and Dror Zaide, and it uses machine learning to improve mental health therapy and talk therapy.
According to the company's executives, therapists spend on average one full day a week on documentation.
Its platform transcribes and summarizes the therapy session and prepares a draft note, which the therapist can submit or edit.
In a trial at the Ozark Center in Missouri, depression and anxiety fell by 34% and 29% in the group that worked with the platform, compared with 20% and 8% in usual treatment.
According to Joffe, the product is installed today at about 130 organizations that treat tens of thousands of patients.

stations.title: Before: therapists facing a pile of paperwork

paragraphs.text: According to a study published in 2023, mental health centers are inundated by referrals and by increasing distress in the communities they serve.
According to the paper, community clinics face longer waitlists of patients with more serious mental health difficulties.
Their therapists carry an unprecedented documentation and administrative burden.
Eleos executives said that therapists describe documentation as the bane of their existence.
According to the Menlo Ventures fund, over 90% of mental health care providers report symptoms of burnout.
According to the fund, the workforce has not kept up with the growth in demand.
In the U.S., the number of mental health sessions rose by 20%, to 330 million a year, according to the fund.
Alon Rabinovich said that when the company started working, COVID broke out, and a huge wave of demand for mental health services arrived.

stations.title: The founders: from the army to the therapy room

paragraphs.text: Alon Joffe, Alon Rabinovich and Dror Zaide founded the company in 2020, while participating in the Zell Entrepreneurship Program at Reichman University.
According to Menlo Ventures, the founders served in the Israeli military and saw firsthand the importance of treatment for colleagues with PTSD.
According to Rabinovich, Alon and Dror saw firsthand their soldiers dealing with mental health conditions, Alon in Unit 669 and Dror as a drone operator.
Joffe, the CEO, said the company was founded after the founders personally witnessed the immense administrative barriers facing clinicians.
The founders were later joined by Dr. Shiri Sade Sharvit, a clinical psychologist.
Sharvit served as Chief Clinical Officer and headed a team of seven clinical psychologists.
Eleos is an Israeli startup that uses machine learning to improve mental health and talk therapy.
According to Axios, the system analyzes the conversation between therapist and patient, with the consent of both parties.
The platform transcribes and summarizes the session, and gives the therapist feedback on their use of evidence-based practices.
Insights from the session are summarized into a draft note, and the therapist can submit it or edit it.
According to Menlo Ventures, the software learns each therapist's style over time.
According to Rabinovich, this saves time and reduces burnout.
Rabinovich said the company is not here to replace therapists, but to give them aids and signals.
According to Rabinovich, access to the data is protected by strict passwords and two-factor authentication.
The trial was conducted at the adult outpatient program at the Ozark Center in Missouri, United States.
Its participants were 47 adults referred for cognitive behavioral therapy because of depression or anxiety.
23 of them were in the AI group and 24 in usual treatment.
Six therapists worked with the platform and eight worked as usual.
Therapists in the Eleos group received a 45-minute training.
Participants in the AI group attended on average 5.24 sessions, compared with 3.14 in usual treatment.
Their depression fell by 34% and their anxiety by 29%, compared with 20% and 8% in usual treatment.
The effect size for depression was 0.82, compared with 0.34 in usual treatment.
For anxiety it was 0.78, compared with 0.14.
Therapists who worked with the platform submitted their notes on average 55 hours earlier.
One of them wrote that the system gave them more time to work with the client, instead of sitting at the computer documenting.
None of the therapists or clients withdrew from the study.
The researchers wrote that this is the first controlled clinical trial to report the efficacy of an artificial intelligence platform for improving behavioral therapy.

stations.title: From the trial to the clinics

paragraphs.text: Eleos has deployed its solution with over a dozen leading provider organizations, among them Solvista Health, Achieve, Yeshiva University and ReachLink.
According to Axios, the company works only with community health providers and federal health centers, which serve areas with inadequate medical services.
According to the report, in 2023 Eleos analyzed more than 3 million minutes of therapy sessions and saved more than 300 days of documentation.
According to Menlo Ventures, documentation times dropped by more than 50%.
According to the fund, providers describe Eleos as “life-changing” and say they would be devastated if it were taken away from them.
According to Joffe, the product is installed by about 130 customers, organizations that treat tens of thousands of patients.
With the launch of Eleos Compliance, the tool flags potential documentation errors before they lead to fines.
According to Eleos Health's announcement of its Series B funding round, in 2023 the platform expanded to serve 23 states in the United States.
In 2021 the company raised $6 million in a Seed round, led by the Israeli fund aMoon.
In 2023 it announced a $40 million Series B round.
The round was led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from F-Prime Capital, Eight Roads, Arkin Digital Health, SamsungNEXT and ION.
The round brought the total amount raised to $68 million.
In January 2025 a $60 million Series C round was completed, led by Greenfield Partners.
The round brought the total amount raised to over $120 million.
That month the company had 160 employees, about half of them in Israel.
Dr. David Shulkin, former U.S. Secretary of Veterans Affairs, is a member of the company's board.
Rabinovich described a future plan for a predictive suicidal risk score.

stations.title: What else to know about the study

paragraphs.text: The researchers themselves wrote that the small sample size and the length of the study are important limitations of the trial.
Most participants' symptoms were mild to moderate at the start of treatment.
94% of the participants were White and 6% were Hispanic or Latino.
Randomization was done at the therapist level, after consent was given.
Therapists could choose which group to join.
After two months, no difference was found between the groups in treatment satisfaction.
Two of the researchers are employees of Eleos Health, which provided the platform.
The study protocol was approved by the Ozark Center's Research Committee, the Freeman Health System Institutional Research Board and the State of Missouri Department of Mental Health.

claims.text: החלוקה האקראית נעשתה ברמת המטפל, אחרי מתן הסכמה.
claims.quote: were randomized at the therapist level to either the Eleos or TAU group after consent

claims.text: המטפלים יכלו לבחור לאיזו קבוצה במחקר להצטרף.
claims.quote: Therapists could choose which study arm they wanted to join

claims.text: לא נמצא הבדל בין הקבוצות בשביעות הרצון מהטיפול ובתפיסת התועלת שלו אחרי חודשיים.
claims.quote: No group difference was found in 2-month treatment satisfaction and perceived helpfulness.

claims.text: שניים מהחוקרים הם עובדי Eleos Health, שסיפקה את הפלטפורמה.
claims.quote: SSS and EG are employees of Eleos Health Inc, which provided the AI platform used in this study.

claims.text: פרוטוקול המחקר אושר על ידי ועדת המחקר של מרכז Ozark, ועדת הלסינקי של Freeman Health System ומחלקת בריאות הנפש של מדינת מיזורי.
claims.quote: The RCT protocol was reviewed and approved by the Ozark Center’s Research Committee, the Freeman Health System Institutional Research Board, and the State of Missouri Department of Mental Health

claims.text: לפי תוצאות המאמר, 72 מבוגרים הוצעו להשתתף ו-47 (65%) נתנו הסכמה.
claims.quote: A total of 72 adults who had been recommended outpatient CBT for a main diagnosis of a depressive or anxiety disorder were offered to participate in this study, of whom 47 (65%) provided their consent.

claims.text: לפי תקציר המחקר, 72 מטופלים אותרו ו-47 מהם (67%) הסכימו להשתתף.
claims.quote: A total of 72 patients were approached, of whom 47 (67%) agreed to participate.

claims.text: לפי החוקרים, הנוכחות בטיפול הייתה גבוהה פי 2 והשיפור בתסמינים טוב פי 3 עד 4 בקרב מטופלים בליווי הפלטפורמה.
claims.quote: The study found that patient attendance in treatment supported by the AI platform was 2 times higher, and improvement in symptoms was 3 to 4 times better in these patients, compared to patients receiving TAU.

claims.text: לפי הדיווח, החברה העסיקה כ-95 עובדים ברחבי העולם, עלייה של 56% לעומת השנה הקודמת.
claims.quote: Today, the company employs approximately 95 people worldwide (a 56% increase compared to last year).

claims.text: לפי הודעת Eleos Health על סבב ההשקעה מסדרה B, בשנת 2023 הפלטפורמה התרחבה כך שהיא משרתת 23 מדינות בארצות הברית.
claims.quote: expanding to serve 23 states
